source.title: Twelve open problems on the exact value of the Hausdorff measure and on topological entropy: a brief survey of recent results

trace.notes: Normalized the input as a zbMATH resolver URL with source slug 2092027. Local corpus metadata and exact-title resolver results identify DOI 10.1088/0951-7715/17/2/007 and the title used in the source object.

The zbMATH URL could not be used as a readable source: shell access to https://zbmath.org/2092027 returned a Cloudflare challenge/403, and the accessible search result content was bibliographic metadata rather than full technical text.

Tried the DOI/publisher route for 10.1088/0951-7715/17/2/007. IOP PDF/landing URLs could not be downloaded reliably in the local environment because DNS resolution failed after an initial header probe, and the available publisher/DeepDyve surfaces were metadata, abstract, or subscription pages rather than readable full text.

Ran exact-work searches for the title, DOI, title plus PDF, and title plus authors. Inspected candidate resolver/search results including PASCAL/INIST, DeepDyve, ScienceDirect reference pages, ResearchGate snippets, and later articles discussing individual follow-up problems. These were rejected because they were metadata, abstracts, citations, snippets, paywalled previews, or different works rather than a readable full-text copy of the same source.

Input could not be normalized to a readable PDF or HTML full-text source. Failure modes observed: blocked_or_challenged for zbMATH, network_or_dns_failure for local publisher/API fetches, and metadata_only/paywalled_or_restricted for recovered candidates.
Saved final JSON to outputs/parse-paper/2092027.json and outputs/latest.json.
